title: 链式法则与数值梯度
code:
import numpy as np
x, w, b, target = 2., 3., 1., 5.
def loss(weight):
    return (weight*x + b - target)**2 / 2
h = 1e-5
analytic = (w*x + b - target)*x
numeric = (loss(w+h)-loss(w-h))/(2*h)
print('loss:', loss(w))
print('analytic gradient:', analytic)
print('numeric gradient:', numeric)
print('close:', np.isclose(analytic, numeric))

title: 高斯 KL 与重参数化
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
mu, sigma = 1., 2.
kl = .5*(mu**2 + sigma**2 - 1 - np.log(sigma**2))
z = mu + sigma*rng.standard_normal(20000)
print('KL(q || N(0,1)):', kl)
print('sample mean / variance:', z.mean(), z.var())
print('expected mean / variance:', mu, sigma**2)

title: 注意力归一化与 mask
code:
import numpy as np
Q = np.array([[1., 0.], [0., 1.]])
K = np.array([[1., 0.], [0., 1.], [1., 1.]])
V = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.], [5., 6.]])
scores = Q @ K.T / np.sqrt(Q.shape[-1])
scores[:, -1] = -np.inf  # 屏蔽最后一个key
weights = np.exp(scores - scores.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))
weights /= weights.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
print('weights:\n', weights)
print('row sums:', weights.sum(axis=-1))
print('output:\n', weights @ V)

title: DDPM 加噪曲线
code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
beta = np.linspace(1e-4, .05, 200)
alpha_bar = np.cumprod(1-beta)
print('final alpha_bar:', alpha_bar[-1])
print('scalar check:', np.sqrt(.25)*2 + np.sqrt(.75)*(-1))
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 3))
plt.plot(alpha_bar, label='signal variance')
plt.plot(1-alpha_bar, label='noise variance')
plt.xlabel('code timestep (0 = math t=1)')
plt.ylabel('variance coefficient')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

title: ODE 与 Brownian 方差
code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
h, steps = .01, 100
paths = np.cumsum(rng.standard_normal((5000, steps))*np.sqrt(h), axis=1)
t = np.arange(1, steps+1)*h
print('Brownian terminal variance:', paths[:, -1].var())
print('Euler x(1):', (1-h)**steps, 'exact:', np.exp(-1))
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 3))
plt.plot(t, paths.var(axis=0), label='empirical variance')
plt.plot(t, t, '--', label='theory: Var(W_t)=t')
plt.xlabel('time')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

title: SciPy 一对一匹配
code:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
C = np.array([[4, 1, 3], [2, 0, 5], [3, 2, 2]])
rows, cols = linear_sum_assignment(C)
print('row -> col:', list(zip(rows.tolist(), cols.tolist())))
print('total cost:', C[rows, cols].sum())
print('试着修改一个代价，再比较全局最优解。')

title: SymPy 符号求导
code:
import sympy as sp
w, x, b, target = sp.symbols('w x b target')
loss = (w*x+b-target)**2 / 2
grad = sp.diff(loss, w)
print('loss:', loss)
print('dL/dw:', sp.factor(grad))
print('at x=2,w=3,b=1,target=5:', grad.subs({x:2,w:3,b:1,target:5}))
